sql.01_profile.sql:
-- 01 · Profile the raw file before touching it.
-- raw_trips is a view over the untouched official Parquet file.

-- name: raw_summary
SELECT
  count(*)                    AS raw_rows,
  min(tpep_pickup_datetime)   AS min_pickup,
  max(tpep_pickup_datetime)   AS max_pickup,
  count(DISTINCT VendorID)    AS vendors
FROM raw_trips;

-- name: duplicate_rows
-- Exact duplicates on the natural key of a trip record.
SELECT coalesce(sum(n - 1), 0) AS duplicate_rows
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS n
  FROM raw_trips
  GROUP BY VendorID, tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime,
           PULocationID, DOLocationID, trip_distance, total_amount
  HAVING count(*) > 1
);
sql.02_clean.sql:
-- 02 · Type, flag and filter.
-- Each raw row is assigned the FIRST rule it violates, so exclusion counts are
-- mutually exclusive and add up exactly: raw = clean + Σ excluded.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE trips_flagged AS
WITH typed AS (
  SELECT
    VendorID                      AS vendor_id,
    tpep_pickup_datetime          AS pickup_ts,
    tpep_dropoff_datetime         AS dropoff_ts,
    PULocationID                  AS pu_zone,
    DOLocationID                  AS do_zone,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance                 AS distance_mi,
    fare_amount,
    tip_amount,
    total_amount,
    payment_type,
    date_diff('second', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime) AS duration_s
  FROM raw_trips
)
SELECT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN pickup_ts IS NULL OR dropoff_ts IS NULL OR pu_zone IS NULL OR do_zone IS NULL
      OR distance_mi IS NULL OR fare_amount IS NULL          THEN 'R01_missing_key_field'
    WHEN pickup_ts <  getvariable('month_start')::TIMESTAMP
      OR pickup_ts >= getvariable('month_end')::TIMESTAMP    THEN 'R02_outside_month'
    WHEN duration_s <= 0                                     THEN 'R03_non_positive_duration'
    WHEN duration_s <  getvariable('min_duration_s')         THEN 'R04_duration_too_short'
    WHEN duration_s >  getvariable('max_duration_s')         THEN 'R05_duration_too_long'
    WHEN distance_mi <= 0                                    THEN 'R06_non_positive_distance'
    WHEN distance_mi >  getvariable('max_distance_mi')       THEN 'R07_distance_too_long'
    WHEN fare_amount <= 0                                    THEN 'R08_non_positive_fare'
    WHEN fare_amount >  getvariable('max_fare_usd')          THEN 'R09_fare_too_high'
    WHEN pu_zone NOT BETWEEN 1 AND getvariable('max_zone_id')
      OR do_zone NOT BETWEEN 1 AND getvariable('max_zone_id') THEN 'R10_unknown_zone'
    WHEN distance_mi / (duration_s / 3600.0)
         > getvariable('max_speed_mph')                      THEN 'R11_implausible_speed'
  END AS exclusion_rule
FROM typed;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE trips_clean AS
SELECT
  pickup_ts,
  dropoff_ts,
  CAST(pickup_ts AS DATE)                               AS pickup_date,
  hour(pickup_ts)                                       AS pickup_hour,
  isodow(pickup_ts)                                     AS iso_dow,       -- 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday
  CASE WHEN isodow(pickup_ts) <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END    AS day_type,      -- 1 = weekday, 2 = weekend
  pu_zone,
  do_zone,
  passenger_count,
  distance_mi,
  fare_amount,
  tip_amount,
  total_amount,
  payment_type,
  duration_s,
  distance_mi / (duration_s / 3600.0)                   AS speed_mph
FROM trips_flagged
WHERE exclusion_rule IS NULL;
sql.03_aggregate.sql:
-- 03 · Pre-aggregate for the browser. The front end never sees a single raw trip:
-- 4.09 M rows collapse into a few thousand cells that are safe to ship as static JSON.

-- KPI cube: every dashboard KPI is a sum/ratio over these additive measures.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_cube AS
SELECT
  day_type,
  pickup_hour,
  count(*)                    AS trips,
  sum(distance_mi)            AS distance_mi,
  sum(fare_amount)            AS fare_usd,
  sum(total_amount)           AS total_usd,
  sum(duration_s) / 60.0      AS duration_min,
  sum(passenger_count)        AS passengers,
  count(passenger_count)      AS passenger_rows
FROM trips_clean
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_daily AS
SELECT pickup_date, any_value(iso_dow) AS iso_dow, count(*) AS trips,
       sum(distance_mi) AS distance_mi, sum(fare_amount) AS fare_usd
FROM trips_clean GROUP BY pickup_date ORDER BY pickup_date;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_dow_hour AS
SELECT iso_dow, pickup_hour, count(*) AS trips,
       count(DISTINCT pickup_date) AS days
FROM trips_clean GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_dist_hist AS
SELECT day_type, pickup_hour,
       least(floor(distance_mi)::INT, getvariable('dist_hist_max_bin')) AS bin_mi,
       count(*) AS trips
FROM trips_clean GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL;

-- Zone × hour demand, pickups and drop-offs side by side.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_zone_hour AS
WITH pu AS (
  SELECT pu_zone AS zone_id, day_type, pickup_hour, count(*) AS pickups
  FROM trips_clean GROUP BY ALL
), d AS (
  SELECT do_zone AS zone_id, day_type, pickup_hour, count(*) AS dropoffs
  FROM trips_clean GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT zone_id, day_type, pickup_hour,
       coalesce(pickups, 0)  AS pickups,
       coalesce(dropoffs, 0) AS dropoffs
FROM pu FULL JOIN d USING (zone_id, day_type, pickup_hour)
ORDER BY ALL;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_zone_stats AS
SELECT pu_zone AS zone_id,
       count(*)                 AS pickups,
       avg(distance_mi)         AS avg_distance_mi,
       avg(fare_amount)         AS avg_fare_usd,
       avg(duration_s) / 60.0   AS avg_duration_min,
       avg(speed_mph)           AS avg_speed_mph
FROM trips_clean GROUP BY pu_zone ORDER BY pu_zone;

-- Origin–destination flows. GROUPING SETS computes the "all days" and "all hours"
-- roll-ups exactly, instead of summing truncated top-N lists in the browser.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_od AS
WITH g AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN grouping(day_type) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE day_type END       AS day_type,    -- 0 = all days
    CASE WHEN grouping(pickup_hour) = 1 THEN -1 ELSE pickup_hour END AS pickup_hour, -- -1 = all hours
    pu_zone, do_zone,
    count(*)               AS trips,
    avg(distance_mi)       AS avg_distance_mi,
    avg(fare_amount)       AS avg_fare_usd,
    avg(duration_s) / 60.0 AS avg_duration_min
  FROM trips_clean
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (pu_zone, do_zone),
    (day_type, pu_zone, do_zone),
    (pickup_hour, pu_zone, do_zone),
    (day_type, pickup_hour, pu_zone, do_zone)
  )
)
SELECT *
FROM g
QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY day_type, pickup_hour ORDER BY trips DESC, pu_zone, do_zone
) <= getvariable('od_top_n')
ORDER BY day_type, pickup_hour, trips DESC, pu_zone, do_zone;

-- Top destinations (dir = 'out') and top origins (dir = 'in') of every zone.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE agg_zone_links AS
WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT pu_zone, do_zone, count(*) AS trips FROM trips_clean GROUP BY ALL
), o AS (
  SELECT 'out' AS dir, pu_zone AS zone_id, do_zone AS other_zone, trips FROM pairs
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY pu_zone ORDER BY trips DESC, do_zone) <= getvariable('zone_top_n')
), i AS (
  SELECT 'in' AS dir, do_zone AS zone_id, pu_zone AS other_zone, trips FROM pairs
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY do_zone ORDER BY trips DESC, pu_zone) <= getvariable('zone_top_n')
)
SELECT * FROM o UNION ALL SELECT * FROM i
ORDER BY dir, zone_id, trips DESC, other_zone;
sql.04_quality.sql:
-- 04 · Quality evidence shown on the Data Engineering page.

-- name: exclusions
SELECT coalesce(exclusion_rule, 'KEPT') AS rule, count(*) AS n
FROM trips_flagged GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

-- name: outliers_iqr
-- Tukey fences on the cleaned table. These rows are FLAGGED, not removed:
-- a $70 airport fare is a statistical outlier but a perfectly valid trip.
WITH q AS (
  SELECT
    quantile_cont(distance_mi, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99]) AS d,
    quantile_cont(fare_amount, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99]) AS f,
    quantile_cont(duration_s / 60.0, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99]) AS t,
    quantile_cont(speed_mph, [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99]) AS s
  FROM trips_clean
), m AS (
  SELECT 'distance_mi' AS metric, d AS q FROM q UNION ALL
  SELECT 'fare_usd', f FROM q UNION ALL
  SELECT 'duration_min', t FROM q UNION ALL
  SELECT 'speed_mph', s FROM q
)
SELECT
  metric,
  q[1] AS p25, q[2] AS p50, q[3] AS p75, q[4] AS p99,
  q[3] + 1.5 * (q[3] - q[1]) AS upper_fence,
  CASE metric
    WHEN 'distance_mi'  THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM trips_clean WHERE distance_mi       > m.q[3] + 1.5 * (m.q[3] - m.q[1]))
    WHEN 'fare_usd'     THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM trips_clean WHERE fare_amount       > m.q[3] + 1.5 * (m.q[3] - m.q[1]))
    WHEN 'duration_min' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM trips_clean WHERE duration_s / 60.0 > m.q[3] + 1.5 * (m.q[3] - m.q[1]))
    ELSE                     (SELECT count(*) FROM trips_clean WHERE speed_mph         > m.q[3] + 1.5 * (m.q[3] - m.q[1]))
  END AS flagged_rows
FROM m;

-- name: headline_kpis
SELECT
  count(*)                               AS total_trips,
  sum(distance_mi)                       AS total_distance_mi,
  avg(distance_mi)                       AS avg_distance_mi,
  avg(fare_amount)                       AS avg_fare_usd,
  sum(fare_amount)                       AS total_fare_usd,
  avg(duration_s) / 60.0                 AS avg_duration_min,
  sum(distance_mi) / (sum(duration_s) / 3600.0) AS avg_speed_mph
FROM trips_clean;
